original_idea.body: # Honesty Under Multilingual Insider-Threat Scenarios. Translate an agentic-misalignment scenario into 2-3 languages, run on an open model, compare blackmail/sabotage rates vs English.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Multilingual eval-coverage gap plausible but the link to catastrophe has a skipped step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Translate + re-run a released scenario; accessible, though translation quality needs care.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused language-swap comparison on one scenario; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Multilingual coverage gap labs underweight; open scenarios.

novelty.reasoning: Multilingual safety variation studied elsewhere; this insider-threat angle plausibly open.
